# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolboy  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face. He has sparkling black eyes that often carry a hostile, curious, or mocking expression.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony is a sullen, impertinent, and mischievous boy who holds girl teachers in contempt. He displays a scornful, swaggering attitude of toleration toward authority, obeying reluctantly as if disputing a point is simply not worth his while. Despite his rebellious behavior and reluctance to be touched by kindly advice, he is noted to be rather cute underneath his sullenness.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

- sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>

## History

After being taken in as an orphan nephew by Mrs. George Pye and her husband, Anthony began attending the Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. From the beginning, he held a hostile attitude toward Anne, expressing the belief that she was no good simply because she was a female teacher. He frequently caused minor trouble in school, such as pouring water from his slate bottle down Aurelia Clay's neck, remaining unmoved when kept in at recess for a talk about how gentlemen should behave. On another occasion, he placed a live mouse inside Anne's desk drawer to startle her. When Anne caught him mocking her, she punished him with a pointer until his bravado broke and tears came to his eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_
